sequence: validate the frozen diagnostic protocol, qualification PASS receipt, source hashes, schemas, cardinalities and ordinals
construct the structural timing records without loading the named identity mapping or named schedule fields
write, hash and make read-only the anonymous structural runtime prediction
only after the anonymous freeze, load the frozen schedule and identity mapping and validate their one-to-one correspondence
produce the named descriptive engineering runtime distributions, G x N x F cells, tail diagnostics, order sensitivity and time-component identifiability
freeze the input inventory, diagnostic outputs, report and terminal receipt

quantiles.method: linear interpolation at p*(n-1) over sorted finite values
quantiles.missingRule: no imputation; a missing or non-finite required timing value fails closed

tailRules.assessmentRule: report every descriptor leader and call one algorithm most prominent only when it has a strict plurality of the five predeclared descriptor leads; otherwise report no single dominant long-tail algorithm
tailRules.orderStrata: lane execution indices 0..251 early, 252..503 middle and 504..755 late
tailRules.smallCellRule: algorithm x core G x N x F cells have n=3; report n, minimum, P50, maximum and range, and do not interpret their P99 as a stable population estimate

directTimingMeasures.interProcessGapMilliseconds: next process creationTimeUtc minus previous process exitedAtUtc
directTimingMeasures.inclusiveLaneBodyMilliseconds: lane receipt laneWallClockMilliseconds; the frozen RunnerV4_2 stopwatch spans RunAlgorithmLane entry through all lane work and raw writes
directTimingMeasures.unityStartup: not separately identifiable because no trustworthy absolute workloadStartUtc exists
directTimingMeasures.exitFinalization: not separately identifiable because no trustworthy absolute workloadEndUtc exists
directTimingMeasures.residualRule: no residual may be relabeled as startup, compute or finalization

formalStPrediction.scope: algorithm-lane collection plus observed strict-serial inter-process gaps; excludes input generation, qualification oracle batches, post-collection acceptance, delivery and analysis
formalStPrediction.pointFormula: sum the P50 process wall of each of the 216 anonymous-lane x core-GNF pilot cells and 216 pooled lane-gap P50 values, then multiply by B
formalStPrediction.conservativeFormula: sum the observed maximum process wall of each of the 216 anonymous-lane x core-GNF pilot cells and 216 pooled lane-gap P99 values, then multiply by B
formalStPrediction.planningBudgetFormula: conservative estimate multiplied by 1.20 operational headroom

scientificBoundary: This is a post-qualification descriptive engineering runtime diagnostic. It does not read outcome observations, estimate scientific effects, rank quality, adjudicate a winner, use qualification rows as formal samples, change the design or authorize ST, MQ or MT execution.
